# strollur

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/ORCID-Patrick%20Schloss-A6CE39.svg)](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6935-4275)
[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/ORCID-Sarah%20Westcott-A6CE39.svg)](https://orcid.org/0009-0001-1529-8247)
[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/ORCID-Gregory%20Johnson-A6CE39.svg)](https://orcid.org/0009-0008-3890-0297)

## Overview

The **`strollur`** package stores the data associated with your Amplicon
Sequence Analysis. This includes nucleotide sequences, abundance, sample
and treatment assignments, taxonomic classifications, sequence bin
assignments, metadata, trees and various reports. It is designed to
facilitate data analysis across multiple R packages with utility
functions to import from [mothur](https://mothur.org),
[qiime2](https://qiime2.org), [dada2](https://benjjneb.github.io/dada2/)
and
[phyloseq](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/phyloseq.html).

- [`add()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/add.md) adds
  sequences, reports, metadata, and resource references
- [`assign()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/assign.md) assigns
  abundances, classifications, bins, samples and treatments and more
- [`names()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/names.md) gets the
  names of sequences, bins, samples, treatments and reports
- [`count()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/count.md) gets the
  number of sequences, bins, samples and treatments
- [`abundance()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/abundance.md)
  gets the abundances for sequences, bins, samples, and treatments
- [`report()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/report.md) gets
  [FASTA](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genbank/fastaformat/) sequences,
  sequence and classification reports, bin assignments, sample
  assignments, metadata, sequence data reports, custom reports, resource
  references and scrapped data reports.
- [`summary()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/summary.md)
  summarizes sequences, your custom reports, and scrapped data

## Installation

You can install the CRAN version with:

``` r

install.packages("strollur")
```

### Development version

You can install the development version of strollur from
[GitHub](https://github.com/mothur/strollur) with:

``` r

pak::pak("mothur/strollur")
```

## Usage

The example below adds
[FASTA](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genbank/fastaformat/) sequence
data, assigns sequence abundance, samples and treatments, as well as
assigning bins and taxonomic data to a [strollur
object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html).

``` r

fasta_data <- read_fasta(strollur_example("final.fasta.gz"))
abundance_table <- readRDS(strollur_example("miseq_abundance_by_sample.rds"))
bin_table <- readRDS(strollur_example("miseq_list_otu.rds"))
classification_data <- read_mothur_taxonomy(taxonomy = strollur_example("final.taxonomy.gz"))

data <- new_dataset(dataset_name = "example")

add(data, table = fasta_data, type = "sequence")
#> Added 2425 sequences.
assign(data, table = abundance_table, type = "sequence_abundance")
#> Assigned 2425 sequence abundances.
assign(data, table = bin_table, type = "bin", bin_type = "otu")
#> Assigned 531 otu bins.
assign(data, table = classification_data, type = "sequence_taxonomy")
#> Assigned 2425 sequence taxonomies.

data
#> example:
#> 
#>             starts ends nbases ambigs polymers numns   numseqs
#> Minimum:         1  375    249      0        3     0      1.00
#> 2.5%-tile:       1  375    252      0        4     0   2849.08
#> 25%-tile:        1  375    252      0        4     0  28490.75
#> Median:          1  375    253      0        4     0  56981.50
#> 75%-tile:        1  375    253      0        5     0  85472.25
#> 97.5%-tile:      1  375    254      0        6     0 111113.93
#> Maximum:         1  375    256      0        6     0 113963.00
#> Mean:            1  375    252      0        4     0  56981.64
#> 
#> Number of unique seqs: 2425 
#> Total number of seqs: 113963 
#> 
#> Total number of samples: 19 
#> Total number of treatments: 2 
#> Total number of otus: 531 
#> Total number of otu bin classifications: 531 
#> Total number of sequence classifications: 2425
```

## Getting help

If you encounter an issue, please file an issue on
[GitHub](https://github.com/mothur/strollur/issues). Please include a
minimal reproducible example with your issue.

## Contributing

Is there a feature you’d like to see included, please let us know! Pull
requests are welcome on
[GitHub](https://github.com/mothur/strollur/pulls).

## Code of Conduct

Please note that the strollur project is released with a [Contributor
Code of Conduct](https://mothur.org/strollur/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html). By
contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

# Package index

## Getting Started

Adding and using data

- [`add()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/add.md) :

  Add sequences, reports, trees or resource references to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`assign()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/assign.md) :

  Assign sequence abundances, sequence classifications, bins, bin
  representative sequences, bin classifications, sample distances or
  treatments to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`names()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/names.md) :

  Get the names of various data in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`count()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/count.md) :

  Find the number of sequences, samples, treatments or bins of a given
  type in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`abundance()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/abundance.md) :

  Get the abundance data for sequences, bins, samples, and treatments in
  a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`report()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/report.md) :

  Get a data.frame containing the given report in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`summary()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/summary.md) :

  Summarize the sequences data, custom reports, and scrapped data in a
  [strollur object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`strollur`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.md) :

  The
  [`strollur::strollur`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.md)
  object

- [`strollur-package`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur-package.md)
  : strollur: Store and Transfer Amplicon Sequence Data

## Importing Data

Importing from other software tools namely: mothur, qiime2, phyloseq and
DADA2

- [`read_biom()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_biom.md) :

  Create a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) from a
  biom formatted file.

- [`read_dada2()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_dada2.md)
  :

  Create a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) from
  dada2 outputs

- [`read_fasta()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_fasta.md)
  :

  Read a [FASTA](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genbank/fastaformat/)
  formatted sequence file

- [`read_fastq()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_fastq.md)
  :

  Read a [FASTQ](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2847217/)
  formatted file

- [`read_mothur()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_mothur.md)
  :

  Create a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) from
  mothur outputs

- [`read_mothur_cons_taxonomy()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_mothur_cons_taxonomy.md)
  :

  Read a mothur formatted [cons_taxonomy
  file](https://mothur.org/wiki/constaxonomy_file/)

- [`read_mothur_count()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_mothur_count.md)
  :

  Read a mothur formatted [count
  file](https://mothur.org/wiki/count_file/)

- [`read_mothur_list()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_mothur_list.md)
  :

  Read a mothur formatted [list
  file](https://mothur.org/wiki/list_file/)

- [`read_mothur_oligos()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_mothur_oligos.md)
  :

  Read a mothur formatted [oligos
  file](https://mothur.org/wiki/oligos_file/)

- [`read_mothur_rabund()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_mothur_rabund.md)
  :

  Read a mothur formatted [rabund
  file](https://mothur.org/wiki/rabund_file/)

- [`read_mothur_shared()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_mothur_shared.md)
  :

  Read a mothur formatted [shared
  file](https://mothur.org/wiki/shared_file/)

- [`read_mothur_taxonomy()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_mothur_taxonomy.md)
  :

  Read a mothur formatted [taxonomy
  file](https://mothur.org/wiki/taxonomy_file/)

- [`read_phyloseq()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_phyloseq.md)
  :

  Create a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) from a
  phyloseq object

- [`read_qiime2()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_qiime2.md)
  :

  Create a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) from a
  qiime2 outputs

- [`read_qiime2_feature_table()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_qiime2_feature_table.md)
  :

  Read a [qiime2](https://qiime2.org) qza containing bin data

- [`read_qiime2_metadata()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_qiime2_metadata.md)
  :

  Read a [qiime2](https://qiime2.org) .tsv table containing metadata.

- [`read_qiime2_taxonomy()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_qiime2_taxonomy.md)
  :

  Read a [qiime2](https://qiime2.org) qza containing taxonomy data

- [`read_quality()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/read_quality.md)
  : Read a file containing sequence quality scores

- [`unpack_qiime2_artifact()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/unpack_qiime2_artifact.md)
  :

  The unpack_qiime2_artifact function reads .qza files created by
  [qiime2](https://qiime2.org), and returns the artifact.

## General

Create datasets and references, clear data

- [`miseq_sop_example()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/miseq_sop_example.md)
  :

  Create a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) using the
  analysis files from the
  [MiSeq_SOP](https://mothur.org/wiki/miseq_sop/) example.

- [`new_dataset()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/new_dataset.md)
  :

  Create a new [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`new_reference()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/new_reference.md)
  :

  Create a resource reference for your [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) to aid in
  reproducibility.

- [`clear()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/clear.md) :

  Clear data from a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`is_aligned()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/is_aligned.md)
  :

  Determine if a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) contains
  aligned sequences.

- [`is_equal()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/is_equal.md) :
  is_equal

- [`has_sample()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/has_sample.md)
  :

  Determine if a given sample is in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`get_bin_types()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/get_bin_types.md)
  :

  Get bin table types of a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

## Data Transfers

Save, copy, load, import, export and write to file

- [`save_dataset()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/save_dataset.md)
  :

  Save the [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) to file.

- [`load_dataset()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/load_dataset.md)
  :

  Load a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) from a
  file.

- [`export_dataset()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/export_dataset.md)
  :

  Create a human readable table containing all data from a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html).

- [`import_dataset()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/import_dataset.md)
  :

  Create a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) from the
  exported table of a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) object.

- [`copy_dataset()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/copy_dataset.md)
  :

  Create a new [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) from an
  existing dataset.

- [`write_biom()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_biom.md)
  :

  Write a [BIOM](https://biom-format.org) formatted file containing a
  [strollur
  object's](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) data.

- [`write_fasta()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_fasta.md)
  :

  Write a [FASTA](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genbank/fastaformat/)
  formatted sequence file

- [`write_fastq()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_fastq.md)
  :

  Write a [FASTQ](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2847217/)
  formatted file

- [`write_mothur()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_mothur.md)
  :

  Write the various [file
  types](https://mothur.org/wiki/tags/#file_types) from your [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) for use
  with mothur.

- [`write_mothur_cons_taxonomy()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_mothur_cons_taxonomy.md)
  :

  Write a mothur formatted [cons_taxonomy
  file](https://mothur.org/wiki/constaxonomy_file/)

- [`write_mothur_count()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_mothur_count.md)
  :

  Write a mothur formatted [count
  file](https://mothur.org/wiki/count_file/)

- [`write_mothur_design()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_mothur_design.md)
  :

  Write a mothur formatted [design
  file](https://mothur.org/wiki/design_file/)

- [`write_mothur_list()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_mothur_list.md)
  :

  Write mothur formatted [list
  files](https://mothur.org/wiki/list_file/)

- [`write_mothur_rabund()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_mothur_rabund.md)
  :

  Write mothur formatted [rabund
  files](https://mothur.org/wiki/rabund_file/)

- [`write_mothur_shared()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_mothur_shared.md)
  :

  Write mothur formatted [shared
  files](https://mothur.org/wiki/shared_file/)

- [`write_phyloseq()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_phyloseq.md)
  :

  Create a phyloseq object from your [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`write_quality()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_quality.md)
  : Write a file containing sequence quality scores

- [`write_taxonomy()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/write_taxonomy.md)
  :

  Write a 2 column [taxonomy
  file](https://mothur.org/wiki/taxonomy_file/)

## Functions for Package Developers

Want to create and modify strollur objects from your package? Check out
these functions

- [`strollur_example()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur_example.md)
  : strollur_example

- [`has_sequence_strings()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/has_sequence_strings.md)
  :

  Determine if a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) contains
  sequence nucleotide strings.

- [`remove_file()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/remove_file.md)
  : remove_file

- [`sort_dataframe()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/sort_dataframe.md)
  : sort_dataframe

- [`xdev_abundance()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_abundance.md)
  : Get a data.frame containing the requested abundance data

- [`xdev_add_references()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_add_references.md)
  :

  Add resource references to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) to aid in
  reproducibility

- [`xdev_add_report()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_add_report.md)
  :

  Add a report to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_add_sequence_fastq_scores()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_add_sequence_fastq_scores.md)
  :

  Add FASTQ data to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_add_sequences()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_add_sequences.md)
  :

  Add sequence data to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_assign_bin_representative_sequences()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_assign_bin_representative_sequences.md)
  : Assign representative sequences to bins

- [`xdev_assign_bin_taxonomy()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_assign_bin_taxonomy.md)
  :

  Assign bin classifications to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_assign_bin_taxonomy_tidy()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_assign_bin_taxonomy_tidy.md)
  :

  Assign bin classifications to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_assign_bins()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_assign_bins.md)
  :

  Add bin assignments to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_assign_sample_distances()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_assign_sample_distances.md)
  :

  Assign samples distances in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_assign_sequence_abundance()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_assign_sequence_abundance.md)
  :

  Assign sequence abundance and optionally assign sample and treatment
  data to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_assign_sequence_quality_scores()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_assign_sequence_quality_scores.md)
  :

  Add quality data to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_assign_sequence_taxonomy()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_assign_sequence_taxonomy.md)
  :

  Assign sequence classifications to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_assign_sequence_taxonomy_tidy()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_assign_sequence_taxonomy_tidy.md)
  :

  Assign sequence classifications to a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_assign_treatments()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_assign_treatments.md)
  :

  Assign samples to treatments in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_count()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_count.md)
  :

  Find the number of sequences, samples, treatments or bins of a given
  type in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_get_alignment_length()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_get_alignment_length.md)

  Get the alignment length of sequences in your [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_get_bin_abundances_by_sample()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_get_bin_abundances_by_sample.md)
  :

  Get the sequence abundance data in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) parsed by
  sample

  Get the requested data in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) parsed by
  sample

- [`xdev_get_list_vector()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_get_list_vector.md)
  : Get vector of strings containing the sequences bin data

- [`xdev_get_sample_distances()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_get_sample_distances.md)
  :

  Get distances between samples in your \`[strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_get_sequence_abundances_by_sample()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_get_sequence_abundances_by_sample.md)
  :

  Get the sequence abundance data in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) parsed by
  sample

- [`xdev_get_sequence_indexes_by_sample()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_get_sequence_indexes_by_sample.md)
  : Get indexes of sequences parsed by sample

- [`xdev_get_sequences()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_get_sequences.md)
  :

  Get the nucleotide strings for each sequence in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_has_bin_taxonomy()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_has_bin_taxonomy.md)
  :

  Determine if a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) has bin
  taxonomy assignments

- [`xdev_has_sequence_taxonomy()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_has_sequence_taxonomy.md)
  :

  Determine if a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) has
  sequence taxonomy assignments

- [`xdev_merge_bins()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_merge_bins.md)
  :

  Merge bins in your [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_merge_sequences()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_merge_sequences.md)
  : Merge sequences combines the abundances of sequences

- [`xdev_names()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_names.md)
  :

  Get the names of a given type of data in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_remove_bins()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_remove_bins.md)
  :

  Remove bins from a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_remove_lineages()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_remove_lineages.md)
  :

  Remove contaminants from a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_remove_samples()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_remove_samples.md)
  :

  Remove samples from a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_remove_sequences()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_remove_sequences.md)
  :

  Remove sequences from a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_report()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_report.md)
  :

  Get a data.frame containing the given report in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_set_abundance()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_set_abundance.md)
  :

  Set abundances of sequences in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) without
  sample data

- [`xdev_set_abundances()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_set_abundances.md)
  :

  Set abundances of sequences in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html) with
  sample data

- [`xdev_set_dataset_name()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_set_dataset_name.md)
  :

  Set the name of a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)

- [`xdev_set_sequences()`](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/xdev_set_sequences.md)
  :

  Set neucleotide sequence string in a [strollur
  object](https://mothur.org/strollur/reference/strollur.html)
